name: Default
shortDescription: Redis and Memcached compatible in-memory data store, with password auth, periodic snapshots to a persistent volume and its HTTP console and JSON command API.

alerts.message: The domain serves the HTTP console and the POST /api command endpoint behind basic auth: user default, password DRAGONFLY_PASSWORD from the environment variables. The Redis protocol port 6379 is not public; other apps in the same environment reach it at dragonfly:6379 with that password.
